Priya Nair: Quick Q — we're landing the API header for explicit model pinning. proposal: `X-Redwood-Model: model-id@version` (example: `rw-instruct-v1@2026-02-15`). Does that sound safe for backward compatibility?
Alex Kim: sounds reasonable. main thing: server must treat this as a hint if not supported by deployment and fall back to the default model variant. no hard 4xx for unknown versions. :+1:
Dena Ortiz: adding: what should deprecation timeline look like when we remove support for an old version? we need clear comms to customers + SDK guards.
Alex Kim: agree. recommendation: 90 days for deprecation notice + 30 day soft-warning period where we return `X-Redwood-Deprecation: true` header and an info field in response metadata. then hard-removal only after agreed enterprise notice windows.
Michael R: can we encode compatibility checks in the header response so SDKs can auto-fallback? e.g. server replies with `X-Redwood-Model-Supported: rw-instruct-v1@2026-02-15, rw-instruct-v1@latest` when a pinned version is partially supported.
Lia Chen: SDK behaviour question — if client pins `rw-instruct-v1@2026-02-15` but server only has `rw-instruct-v1@2026-03-01`, should the SDK auto-accept minor version bumps or surface an error?
Alex Kim: policy: allow patch/bugfix+minor releases within the same major model family to be compatible. only major-model changes (architecture changes) are breaking. SDK should attempt a 3-step fallback: 1) exact match, 2) compatible minor/patch, 3) default model. surface a warning log on 2 and an explicit error on 3 if the request specified `strict=true`.
Priya Nair: noted. so we need API semantics: new query param `strict=true|false` (default false). and header semantics documented. Lia, can you add SDK PR to implement fallback logic?
Lia Chen: yep, I'll add a feature flag and tests. also want an integration test that mocks a server sending `X-Redwood-Model-Supported` and verifies fallback path.
Dena Ortiz: about deprecation notifications — ops wants a webhook and a console banner. propose: 1) webhook to admins 2) dashboard banner 3) email for enterprise. 90 + 30 window as Alex said.
Michael R: rollout plan: canary with 5% traffic using the new header parsing for 48h, monitor anomalies for output regression/eval metric drop. rollback flag ready.
Alex Kim: also add `response.metadata.model_version` in the JSON response so downstream logging has the actual served model id. example: `{"model": "rw-instruct-v1", "model_version": "2026-03-01"}` in response.metadata. keeps observability tight.
Priya Nair: agreed. small nit: ensure we don't expose internal variant ids — use public catalog ids. ops to map internal->public.
deploy-bot: release created: "model-pin-header-v1" -> build 9823. Canary route: eng-platform-canary. :rocket:
Priya Nair: action items: Alex - update API spec + deprecation header names. Lia - SDK fallback + tests. Dena - deprecation comms plan & webhook spec. Michael - canary runbook + metrics to monitor. I'll send a short RFC and timeline doc after today's async sync. Thanks all :green_heart:
